subject: Nimbus MAP: private marketplace offer + milestone-linked pricing
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Torres <evelyn.t@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-10T15:02:00Z
Subject: Nimbus MAP: private marketplace offer + milestone-linked pricing

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our discussion, I’m putting a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) in writing so we can align timing, success criteria for the evaluation, and how marketplace private-offer pricing will step down as you commit/ramp. High level:

- Evaluation period: 4 weeks (POC + performance checks) targeting 2026-07-08 completion.
- MAP milestones tied to private-offer price tiers:
  * Evaluation sign-off (end of POC) -> 10% pilot discount applied to first 3 months.
  * 3-month committed spend (monthly commit) -> additional 7% commit discount.
  * 12-month reserved private offer (annual commit) -> further 12% enterprise discount and waived onboarding credits.

I’m attaching a simple milestone schedule (MAP_Milestones.xlsx) and a draft SOW (Nimbus_SOW_v2.pdf) with technical scope and acceptable latency targets for your infra. We’ll need a private offer on AWS Marketplace (private listing) with the staged pricing profiles so HubSpot/Procure can accept the terms without re-negotiating at each step.

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the MAP and confirm evaluation criteria (performance, throughput, security checklist) by Mon 6/15.
2) We set up a short signature-ready private offer draft for Procurement by 6/18 so Nimbus legal can review.
3) Run POC 6/22–7/06 and sync on evaluation results week of 7/06.

If those milestones look reasonable I’ll loop in our Marketplace ops person and Legal to prepare the AWS private-offer template and DocuSign envelope.

Thanks — talk soon.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

[Attachment: MAP_Milestones.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: Nimbus_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)]

Subject: Re: Nimbus MAP: private marketplace offer + milestone-linked pricing

Thanks Karthik — this is helpful. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Evaluation criteria: performance (95th pct latency < 250ms for 2k qps), data residency in us-east-1, SOC2 evidence required.
- Procurement note: we prefer the private offer to contain a clear pricing staircase tied to milestones (pilot price -> month-to-month committed price -> annual reserved price). That avoids multiple procurements.
- Legal note (from Jake): we’ll need indemnity language and a clause for data handling; I’ll redline once we get the private-offer draft.

Evelyn

Team — forwarding Evelyn’s replies and the key asks from Procurement/Legal. Action items:

- Marissa: can you draft the AWS private-offer template with three SKU tiers that map to the MAP spreadsheet (pilot / committed monthly / annual reserved)? We need the SKU ID placeholders and step-down prices so Procurement can review. Target: internal draft by 6/16.
- Monica: please prepare the SOC2 evidence bundle and short security appendix for the SOW. Evelyn asked specifically for data residency controls and audit log retention.
- Priyom: confirm that our runtime can meet 95th pct <250ms at 2k qps in us-east-1; if we need a dedicated pool we should flag in the SOW (cost impact noted).

I’ll handle the HubSpot private-offer creation and coordinate with Marketplace Ops for the DocuSign flow.

Karthik

Date: 2026-06-12T08:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Nimbus MAP: private marketplace offer + milestone-linked pricing

All — attached is a first pass at the MAP-linked SKU pricing matrix. Notes:

- Pilot SKU (pilot-nimbus-001): list price $0.45/token unit, pilot discount 10% -> $0.405/token unit. Valid for first 90 days post-activation.
- Committed monthly SKU (commit-nimbus-003): post-pilot when Nimbus signs a 3-month monthly commit defined in the private offer. Commit discount additional 7% off list (stacked with pilot if signed mid-pilot).
- Annual reserved SKU (reserve-nimbus-001y): 12-month reservation triggers the 12% enterprise discount on top of prior adjustments and includes waived onboarding credit of $25k.

I added a fallback clause: if SLA targets are missed during evaluation, we offer a one-time remediation credit but preserve the pilot pricing for the evaluation window.

Attaching the spreadsheet (MAP_Milestones.xlsx) with the exact price math and example invoice lines. Please sanity-check, Priyom — I annotated the potential cost impact if we require dedicated nodes in us-east-1.

[Attachment: MAP_Milestones.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

—Marissa
Director, Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Karthik / Evelyn —

Reviewed Marissa’s pricing matrix this morning. Legal is comfortable with the staged pricing approach provided Redwood includes:

1) Clear milestone definitions (dates and acceptance criteria) embedded in the private-offer attachment.
2) An explicit mechanism where procurement can accept the private-offer once (single-signature flow) and the pricing auto-upgrades/downgrades per the MAP without renegotiation.
3) Standard indemnity / data handling language redlines which I’ll attach after internal review.

We’re good to proceed to a signature-ready private offer. Please send the DocuSign link once you’ve uploaded the final private-offer package.

Jake Lin
Sr. Counsel, Nimbus Analytics
jake.lin@nimbus.ai
